description.zh: 马拉喀什古城（麦地那）是摩洛哥最具活力的历史城区，德吉玛·埃尔芙纳广场是其心脏地带。迷宫般的市集（苏克）中出售各式手工艺品、香料和皮革，色彩绚烂，气息浓郁。
description.en: Marrakech Medina is Morocco's most vibrant historic quarter. Djemaa el-Fna square is its beating heart; the labyrinthine souks sell crafts, spices and leather in a riot of colour and aroma.

location.zh: 马拉喀什省，摩洛哥中南部

zh: 联合国教科文组织世界遗产麦地那（旧城区）
德吉玛广场：蛇舞者、水卖者、露天餐厅的热闹集市
萨阿迪王朝陵墓和巴伊亚宫殿的精美伊斯兰装饰
en: Djemaa el-Fna square — snake charmers, water sellers and open-air food stalls
Saadian Tombs and Bahia Palace — exquisite Islamic ornamentation

admission.zh: 麦地那免费进入，各宫殿景点10—70迪拉姆不等
admission.en: Medina free to enter; palaces/tombs 10–70 MAD each

tips.zh: 进入麦地那窄巷极易迷路，建议下载离线地图。摩托车在小巷内快速穿行，注意安全；与摊贩砍价是常态。
tips.en: It's easy to get lost in the medina — download offline maps. Motorbikes move fast through alleys, so stay alert. Bargaining is expected at market stalls.

description.zh: 梅尔祖卡附近的尔格谢比沙丘是摩洛哥最壮观的沙漠景观，沙丘高达150米。骑骆驼穿越金色沙海、在沙漠帐篷中仰望星空，是无与伦比的非洲体验。
description.en: The Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga — up to 150 m high — are Morocco's most spectacular desert scenery. Camel trekking through the golden sea of sand and sleeping under stars in a desert camp are unforgettable.

location.zh: 德拉-塔菲拉莱特大区，摩洛哥东南部

zh: 撒哈拉沙漠东大门，埃尔格-谢比沙丘高达150米
骑骆驼入沙漠、夜宿帐篷营地、沙海中看日落日出
晴空万里的星空是北非最壮观的天文体验之一
en: Gateway to the Sahara; Erg Chebbi dunes reach 150 m
Camel trekking, desert camp overnight, sunrise and sunset in the dunes
One of North Africa's finest stargazing experiences under clear desert skies

admission.zh: 沙漠骑驼+营地体验约500—1,500摩洛哥迪拉姆/人

tips.zh: 从菲斯驾车约8小时或从马拉喀什约10小时；10月至4月气候宜人，7—8月白天极热（可超45°C）。
tips.en: About 8 hours from Fez or 10 from Marrakech. October–April is ideal; July–August daytime heat can exceed 45°C — stick to dawn and dusk activities.

description.zh: 舍夫沙万是摩洛哥北部里夫山中的小城，以几乎所有建筑都涂成靛蓝色和白色而闻名，被誉为「蓝色珍珠」。蜿蜒的蓝色小巷、手工艺品商店和友善的当地居民使其成为摩洛哥最受欢迎的拍照胜地。
description.en: Chefchaouen is Morocco's 'Blue Pearl' — a mountain town in the Rif where nearly every building is painted in shades of indigo and white. Its winding blue lanes and craft shops make it Morocco's most photogenic destination.

location.zh: 舍夫沙万省，摩洛哥北部

zh: 「蓝色之城」，旧城街道和房屋全部刷成深浅不一的蓝色
利夫山区（Rif Mountains）中的宁静山城
手工艺集市以当地羊毛织物和皮革制品著称
en: The 'Blue City' — medina streets and buildings painted in every shade of blue
Tranquil mountain town in the Rif Mountains
Craft market renowned for local wool textiles and leather goods

tips.zh: 清晨7点前光线柔和且游客极少，是拍摄蓝色街道的最佳时机；从非斯或丹吉尔驾车约3小时可达。
tips.en: Before 7 a.m., the light is soft and the streets nearly empty — the best time to photograph. About 3 hours from Fez or Tangier by car.
